summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin, without running tests or committing. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py always returns Update (empty path applies translatePrologue to q.prologue[0]); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra and its docstring is updated; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py with nine tests. Not verified: tests, DAWG tests, and black formatting were not run. Known gaps: pprintAlgebra debug output now shows the algebra list as a single item; the initial-bindings acceptance criterion has no test.
